economy.summary: His campaign platform supports raising the minimum wage, paid family leave, universal pre-K, and strengthening labor unions, and promotes workforce programs and job training for careers that do not require four-year degrees. He also sponsored a bill he says protects tenants in their homes and holds bad landlords accountable.
economy.short: Supports raising minimum wage, paid leave, unions, tenant protections.

taxes.summary: Supported Gov. Shapiro's 2025-26 budget proposal, citing more than $1 billion in property tax relief through the homestead and farmstead exclusion, increases in basic and special education funding, and housing repair and first-time homebuyer funds; he said raising the minimum wage to $15 would generate economic activity and about $100 million in annual state revenue.
taxes.short: Supported Shapiro budget citing property tax relief, education funding.

abortion.summary: Cosponsored House Bill 1957, a proposed amendment to the Pennsylvania Constitution providing for personal reproductive liberty, which the House passed 102-101 in December 2025.
abortion.short: Cosponsored constitutional amendment providing for personal reproductive liberty.

education.summary: His campaign says he championed Pennsylvania's largest-ever increase in public education funding to pass the House, accounting for historical inequities in funding, and fought for universal free breakfast for every public school student.
education.short: Championed increased public school funding, universal free student breakfast.

healthcare.summary: His campaign website says he is working to make healthcare affordable; the site does not detail specific healthcare proposals.
healthcare.short: Says he is working to make healthcare affordable.

guns.summary: His campaign platform advocates common-sense gun safety laws, responsible gun storage and use, and accessible mental health treatment, and cites support for fire department funding and public safety grants for local law enforcement.
guns.short: Advocates gun safety laws, responsible storage, law enforcement funding.
